sentences.en: The young campers were kited out with new waterproof jackets.
sentences.zh: 这些露营的小家伙们都穿上了新的防水夹克。

sentences.en: "Stop crying. You'll ruin your mascara." "Don't worry, it's waterproof."
sentences.zh: "别哭了，你会弄花妆的。" "别担心，我的睫毛膏是防水的。"

sentences.en: To keep their thick fur waterproof, sea otters spend hours grooming.
sentences.zh: 为了保持厚厚的皮毛不被水浸湿，海獭会花费好几个小时进行梳理。
